name: Dev Activity Watcher
author: dhirajarya
description: Local-only developer activity tracker: today's per-app time and weekly top apps for editors, AI agents, browsers, and terminals. No network, no telemetry, 7-day retention.

barWidget.description: Today's developer app usage at a glance with an expandable breakdown. Tracks editors, AI agents, browsers, and terminals only; reads a local status file written by the atwd daemon — nothing leaves this machine.

schema.label: Dim the widget while idle
schema.description: Dims the bar item and its tooltip mentions the idle state when you are AFK.
